title: Reassign lead technician does not offer a non-technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so work order 1 has a technician lead.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member C, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B, with one approved line, line 1, so the work order has a lead and a line.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's card more-actions menu.
  2. Click Reassign lead technician.
  3. Type staff member A's first name in the window's search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The more-actions menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The Reassign lead technician window opens and offers staff member C.

Step 3:

  • The window shows the existing message No technicians match “[what you typed]”.
  • Staff member A is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R4: “The Assign lead technician and Reassign lead technician window (from a card's more-actions menu on Board View or Tech View) offers only people per S3-R1. Searching for anyone else shows the existing No technicians match “[search]” message. A current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 is listed last, cannot be picked, and is labeled "Current · no longer assignable"; searching for their name finds that entry.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View", pictures "Reassign lead technician, searching "Oli"" (This build) and "Reassign lead technician, searching "Oli"" (Production today (before))

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p5-08-after-reassign-lead-technician-searching-oli.png
  • tt-p5-07-before-reassign-lead-technician-searching-oli.png

The design's own words:

  • “No match: "No technicians match "Oli"". Only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on are offered.”
  • “Opened from a card's more-actions menu on Board View. Olivia Garrett is offered as a lead.”

The design draws the Reassign lead technician window only; Assign lead technician is not drawn.
